description: Test current iPhone and Android sizes, Safari and Chrome, portrait/landscape, forms, chat, videos, downloads, and checkout.
nextAction: Hand findings to August Launch row 187 (Fix Responsive and Touch Issues). Nia retests participant experience after fixes. Founder acceptance stays with Kimberly Walker (human).

limits.note: This Linux Cloud Agent VM has Chromium only. Safari was exercised via iOS Safari and Chrome-iOS user-agent strings plus static WebKit review (playsInline, 16px text inputs, safe-area, -webkit-mask). No physical iPhone/Android and no macOS/iOS Safari. Architect chat, Journey chapter players, and Blueprint PDF downloads require a signed-in 18+ session; those surfaces were login-gated and reviewed in code/CSS, not as a live participant session. Offer checkout redirects unauthenticated users to login before Stripe. Canonical thebackhalf.org / www.thebackhalf.org did not resolve from this workstation (pre-existing Row 75 DNS note).

home.detail: Hero, manifesto/contact nav, language switcher, and Begin Your Journey render on all five CSS viewports. No horizontal overflow. iPhone landscape (height 393) clips the hero CTA below the fold.

forms.detail: Age gate radios + Continue work. After 18+ confirmation, registration and support forms are usable; fields use 16px text (iOS zoom-safe). Login and forgot-password are public and usable. Support and register stay behind AgeGatedSection until eligible. Radio controls themselves are 16×16; labels are the actual tap area. Language switcher and header/footer links are below 44px height. Forms were filled, not submitted (no account, ticket, or email created).

chat.detail: Public /lumina opening control reveals the Lumina page on iPhone 16 and Pixel 9. Authenticated Architect Lumina chat (/architect/lumina) correctly redirects to /login?next=/architect/lumina. Composer CSS already uses sticky safe-area padding and min-h-11 send/retry controls. Live chat send/receive was not exercised without a session.

videos.detail: Founder review page loaded 18 <video> elements with playsInline and controls. Players stay inside the viewport in portrait and landscape (example iPhone 16 portrait 359×202; landscape 766×431). Chrome Pixel 7 device-mode playback of Founding Architect Welcome worked with captions. Several Spanish sources stayed at readyState 0 during the automated pass (load timing, not layout). Portrait-shot Founder video is pillarboxed in the 16:9 frame. Authenticated Journey chapter players redirect to login.

downloads.detail: Blueprint PDF routes (/api/architect/blueprint/*) and Architect Resources require authentication. Unauthenticated /architect/resources redirects to /login?next=/architect/resources. Download links stack as a column below 640px in ResourcesShell. No live PDF download without a session.

checkout.detail: Public catalog lists Blueprint $1,500, Founding Architect $1,750, Community $50/month with Continue CTAs and 18+ disclosure. Unauthenticated /checkout/blueprint redirects to login (page-level session check). Stripe Checkout was not opened and no card data was entered. Catalog has no horizontal overflow on the five viewports.

findings.title: Public header and footer tap targets are below 44px
findings.detail: Repeated across iPhone and Android sizes: Manifesto/Contact ~80×15, language switcher English/Español ~78×25, brand lockup ~139×17, footer legal/support links ~18px tall, Forgot password 112×18. Primary CTAs (Sign in, Continue, Create account, Lumina send) already use min-h-11. WCAG 2.5.8 AA is 24×24; several nav links are below that height.

findings.title: iPhone landscape hero CTA sits below the short viewport
findings.detail: On 852×393 (iPhone 16/17 landscape) the homepage hero headline fits but Begin Your Journey is clipped at the bottom edge. Not horizontal overflow; short-viewport vertical clip. Needs row 187 hero density/scroll treatment.

findings.title: Age-gate radios are 16×16 controls
findings.detail: Eligibility, register, and support age gates use 16px radios (h-4 w-4). The wrapping label is the intended hit area. Still a touch-precision issue on compact Android (360 CSS px).

findings.title: Founder video is portrait content in a 16:9 frame
findings.detail: Review players keep aspect-video and do not overflow, but the source is pillarboxed. Confirm intended presentation on mobile Safari/Chrome before launch; optional object-fit/frame work is row 187, not this test row.

findings.title: Authenticated mobile chat, downloads, and offer checkout were not live-session tested
findings.detail: Correct login redirects were confirmed for /architect/lumina, /architect/resources, /architect/journey/chapter-1, and /checkout/{offer}. A real Architect session plus Stripe sandbox checkout on a physical device remains open work for Founder/Nia acceptance, not claimed here.

staticSafariReview.viewportMeta: Next.js default width=device-width (no custom viewport export; no user-scalable=no)

validation.note: Status-only ops JSON. package.json has no typecheck or test script. npm run build was not run because this is not a production software change.

evidence: chromium matrix 11 sessions / 167 HTTP 200 page loads
Chrome DevTools Pixel 7 interactive pass: home, register, login, forgot-password, support, eligibility, checkout, lumina, architect login gates, founder video play+captions
